---
title: Cold Ricotta and Tuna Bites
id: MAR-0061
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 150 g ricotta
- 250 g tuna in oil
- 80 g cream cheese
- 2 tablespoons parsley
- 1 tablespoon capers
- 1 spring onion
- 2 egg yolks
- to taste lemon juice and lemon zest from 1 lemon
## Method
1. Salt and pepper. Sift the ricotta, collecting it in a bowl.
2. Add the cream cheese, the egg yolks and mix.
3. Add the drained and crumbled tuna, the chopped capers with the spring onion, the parsley, the lemon zest, a grind of black pepper and mix everything.
4. Adjust salt, cover the bowl with plastic wrap and put it in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
5. With the mixture form many small balls, arrange them on a serving plate, wet them with the lemon juice and serve.
